documentation.title: Batch Size Flag
documentation.standard:
Bulk commands (migrate, sync, import, export, regenerate, rebuild, process, batch, bulk, reindex) should let users tune batch volume with --batch-size (or --per-page) for constrained hosts. Same-class helpers are followed.
Requirement: F3 (SHOULD, warning). Error codes: MissingBatchSizeFlag. Properties: ignoreMethods (method names that are never commands), ignoreClasses (classes that are never command classes).
